name: Levels Of Hell
overview: Scripture reveals that punishment in hell varies according to one's knowledge and deeds, with some receiving more severe judgment than others, as Jesus indicates that certain cities will face harsher condemnation than Sodom and Gomorrah (Matthew 10:15). The Lord also teaches that servants who knowingly disobey will suffer many stripes (Luke 12:47), suggesting degrees of punishment. Ultimately, the lake of fire is portrayed as a place of eternal torment for the devil, the beast, and the false prophet (Revelation 20:10), as well as the final destiny for the fearful, unbelieving, and sinful, described as the second death (Revelation 21:8).
